program.name: CalFresh basic pre-screen
program.description: A limited San Diego CalFresh pre-screen using household, gross-income, and student signals.

versions.source_label: County of San Diego CalFresh Desk Aids: household composition, student eligibility, non-financial factors, income, and 10/2025 assistance standards
versions.notice: Pre-screen only. County eligibility staff make the final decision. Net income, deductions, verification, 2026 work rules, and current noncitizen rules can still change the result.

conditions.pass_reason: The entered ZIP appears to be in San Diego County.
conditions.fail_reason: This pilot only evaluates San Diego County routes.
conditions.unknown_reason: A ZIP code is needed for county routing.
conditions.expected_text: A ZIP routed to San Diego County

conditions.fail_reason: Household size must be at least one.
conditions.unknown_reason: Food-household size is needed for the correct income limit.

conditions.pass_reason: Reported gross monthly income is within the 200% FPL MCE screening ceiling for the reported household size.
conditions.fail_reason: Reported gross monthly income is above this basic 200% FPL screen; a worker should review household composition and any program-specific exception.
conditions.unknown_reason: Approximate gross monthly income is needed for this screen.

when.pass_reason: The half-time higher-education student rule needs review.
when.fail_reason: The special half-time student restriction was not reported.
when.unknown_reason: Student enrollment status could change the result.

conditions.pass_reason: A majority school meal plan was not reported.
conditions.fail_reason: A school meal plan providing more than half of meals may make the student ineligible as a separate CalFresh household member.
conditions.unknown_reason: Meal-plan information is needed for the student route.

conditions.pass_reason: At least one potential student exemption was selected.
conditions.fail_reason: No listed student exemption was selected; an authorized worker should check all exceptions.
conditions.unknown_reason: A potential student exemption must be reviewed.
conditions.expected_text: At least one listed student exception

conditions.not_applicable_reason: The special half-time student branch does not apply based on the answer provided.
conditions.label: Student-specific CalFresh rules

next_steps.MAY_QUALIFY: Use BenefitsCal, 211, GetCalFresh support, or a County Family Resource Center for the official application and calculation.
next_steps.NEEDS_INFORMATION: Answer only the missing questions you can; direct food resources remain available.
next_steps.LIKELY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Ask a benefits worker to review household composition, student exceptions, and other pathways before relying on this result.
next_steps.RULE_UNDER_REVIEW: SANDI is refreshing this pre-screen. You can still use the official application or navigator links while the screening rules are updated.

result_summaries.DIRECT_RESOURCE: Available to everyone without completing the eligibility survey.
result_summaries.LIKELY_ELIGIBLE: Your current answers meet every rule included in this pre-screen. The official agency still decides.
result_summaries.MAY_QUALIFY: Your current answers make this a useful next step, but the provider or agency must confirm remaining requirements.
result_summaries.NEEDS_INFORMATION: A small number of unanswered items could change this result.
result_summaries.LIKELY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: At least one current answer does not meet this pre-screen. Open the details to compare what was expected with what you entered.
result_summaries.RULE_UNDER_REVIEW: SANDI is refreshing this program's screening rules. This is not caused by any answer you gave.
